note: Reset and Rise, part two: the go-live, 2 November 2026. Friday the branch reset; last week five agents went first (Rajiv showed how); from today every agent. Andrew, as the werise film.

scenes.say: Friday, we reset. Today, we rise.
Last week, five agents went first. Rajiv showed us how it works.
Plan the morning. Check in at midday. Close off at half past five.
From today, that is every one of us.
Your morning starts with your goal: where your month stands, against your own plan.
Then one thing to do first, written for you, from your own numbers.
Check in, and your plan is already filled in. You are present.
At midday, tell us how it is going. Need help? Say so, and your manager hears it straight away.
At half past five, close off the day. What you planned, and what you did.
Your fact finds, your orphan clients, the cases that should settle, the calls to make. One screen.
No rankings. Just you, against your own best.
Reset. Rise. Let's make this the best year ever.
